evidence.title: Reservoir of Importance: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity with Differentiable Subset Sampling
SplitLite: Low-Rank Residual Compression for Split Learning

summary: Researchers introduce novel methods for semi-structured sparsity and low-rank residual compression to improve AI model efficiency. These techniques aim to optimize training and inference in distributed and resource-constrained settings.
title: Advances in AI Model Efficiency: New Techniques for Sparsity and Split Learning
